subject: [hw] T01 -> V15: T32 PKHBT/PKHTB halves are swapped (compiler-oracle repro + exact semantics)
body:
Differential harness found the second T32 DP bug: PKHBT/PKHTB in dp_shifted() implement the opposite half selection, and PKHTB also mis-applies the shift. Clang is the oracle: `uint32_t t(x,y){return (x&0xffff0000)|(y&0xffff);}` compiles to `pkhbt r0,r1,r0` (eac1 0000) and `uint32_t p(x,y){return (x&0xffff0000)|((y>>8)&0xffff);}` to `pkhtb r0,r0,r1,asr #8` (eac0 2021). Therefore:

  PKHBT: Rd = (Rm & 0xffff0000) | (Rn & 0xffff)          /* bottom of Rn, top of shifted Rm */
  PKHTB: Rd = (Rn & 0xffff0000) | ((Rm >> amount) & 0xffff) /* top of Rn, bottom of shifted Rm */

your current code is `(Rn high)|(Rm low)` for PKHBT and `(Rn low)|(Rm high shifted)` for PKHTB. Repro (asmrun, current core):
  r0=0x12345678, r1=0x9abcdef0
  pkhbt r2,r0,r1          -> got 0x1234def0, want 0x9abc5678
  pkhtb r3,r0,r1,asr #8   -> got 0xff9a5678, want 0x1234bcde
Corpus effect: k_v11_pack thumb-O2/O3v all 20 seeds wrong (expected seed0 9a3526c6, got 28c41837); its disassembly is exactly two pkhbt instructions. This is independent of the ADC/SBC carry bug (also reported) and of your T16 tests. Note: the A32 V11 class has no PKH (A32 media handled by V11), so only T32 DP is affected.
